mods.name: SeedCopy
mods.description: A server-side command to print the world seed in chat. Unofficial port of SeedCopy by TheSatanicSanta (originally for 1.12.2) to Minecraft 26.3. Original mod: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/seedcopy. This is an unofficial port — all credit for the original concept and logic goes to TheSatanicSanta. Code updated to 26.3 by Itamio.
